text_block_list.text:
One day, a short while after <chrname>'s debut race 
had ended.

The holding of the U.A.F. was publicly 
announced, along with news of the test 
tournament, but—

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That tournament Elfy was promoting on 
stream the other day... "U.A.F.", was it? 
What do you think about it?

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's novel, I'll give you that. I 
just wonder if it'll actually get people 
hyped up, honestly—

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, we already have something as 
massive as the Twinkle Series, right?

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! If people wanna see Umamusume 
shining, they're naturally gonna go check 
out the races instead, huh.

From the public reactions to the "U.A.F." 
that I've been hearing, there seemed to be 
a slight sense of... bewilderment.
Amidst such changes, as for myself and <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Helllooo, everyone! Thanks for all your 
hard work again today!!

“—Today, on Tracen Academy's grounds, 
another joint practice session was being 
held by the competitors for the trial 
meet.”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I know you must be tired right 
after practice, but do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Actually... there's something I'd like to 
consult you about, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Would it be all right if you and I filmed 
a video together, <chrname>-san?!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Elfie. I think we should explain our 
current situation to the Trainer first.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I'm so sorry, I got ahead of 
myself...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Allow me to add a little more 
detail.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Currently, we are running various 
promotions to increase awareness of the 
'U.A.F.'

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Among them, there is a video where Elfi 
demonstrates and explains the U.A.F. 
events—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
If it is agreeable to you, we would like 
<chrname>-san to make an appearance in that video 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—Having active competitors from the 
Twinkle Series join the U.A.F. carries 
tremendous significance for this 
tournament.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Our aim is to broadly promote the 
tournament's depth of talent by having you 
co-star with Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Also, I want to shoot this in a match 
format! That way, the heat of the 
competition and the tension will really 
electrify the viewers!
choice_data_list: So, you chose <chrname> as your opponent?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Watching <chrname>'s dedicated training 
convinced me beyond a doubt that she's the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
At present, joint practices are likely 
your only opportunity to compete against 
other runners.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you might utilize this as a 
valuable opportunity for actual combat 
practice... What do you think?

True, opportunities to compete under 
conditions so close to the real thing are 
exceedingly rare right now. It seems well 
worth accepting the offer...

"—Afterward, I discussed it with <chrname>, and we 
agreed to cooperate on shooting the 
video."

A few days later, filming began with 
Sonnet Elfie for a mock-battle sports 
introduction video—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
――First up is the giant hammer throw, the 
"Dynamic Hammer"!

"The 'Dynamic Hammer' is an event where 
competitors throw a hammer several times 
larger than the ones used by humans to see 
who can throw it the farthest."

Made possible only by the power of an 
Umamusume, its true-to-name dynamism is 
the main attraction.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Allow me to go first!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooooooh!!! Here I goooooooooooo!!!

The giant hammer thrown by Sononet Elfie 
carved a magnificent arc through the air--

Accompanied by an earth-shaking roar, she 
smashed a record never seen before in 
practice!

The next event is 'Godspeed Karate.' 
Participants compete to see how many of 
the surrounding boards they can destroy 
with strikes within the time limit.

"It's an event where the explosive power 
and strength unique to Umamusume are on 
full display, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Here I go!! âSeyaaaaaaaah!!!
(RATATATATATATATATATATATATATATATAT!!)

—Sonon Elfie, moving at a speed that made 
it look like she created clones, broke 
almost every board around her!

—And at last, it was time to film the 
final event: 'Hell Swim Shoot.'

Grab the ball on land, dive into the pool, 
and shoot into the goal above the water. 
They compete on how many times they can 
pull this off within the time limit.

It was an intense sport that heavily 
tested both speed and stamina going back 
and forth between land and water, so 
demanding that just watching took one's 
breath away, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

Hardly losing any speed as she moved, 
Sononet Elfie accurately sank shot after 
shot into the goal...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...All right!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...Phew~! Gave it everything I've got~!

When all was said and done, Sonon Elfie 
put on an astounding performance across 
all 15 events—

<chrname> also gave it her all in the competition, 
but ended up trailing far behind Sonon 
Elfie in the overall score...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, <chrname>! Thank you so very much for your 
hard work today!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank you very much! I think it's 
because I was able to compete with <chrname>-san 
with everything I had! And besides—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to ensure I bring no shame, 
neither as an athlete nor as a 
representative of 'U.A.F.'!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Working together with everyone to put on a 
great meet... frankly, I intend to become 
the No. 1 athlete Umamusume!

I suddenly wondered how someone with such 
incredible physical ability and passion 
ended up becoming an UmaTuber.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes! What is it!?
choice_data_list:
...Why did you start your UmaTuber 
activities?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Why, to spread the joy of sports across 
the whole wide world with a bang, of 
course!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, it's not like I set out to 
become an UmaTuber right from the start, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
You might already know this, Trainer, but 
I'm actually a Tracen Academy alumna...

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"...Even as someone who's loved sports 
since childhood, racing was always 
something I truly looked up to."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
So, when I worked my hardest and actually 
got in, I was sooooo happy, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
In the end, as an athlete, I wasn't able 
to leave behind any remarkable results in 
races.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I had no regrets. If anything, I 
felt a sparkling sense of profound 
emotion...!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Competing seriously with all your 
might...! Pushing past your own limits...! 
Connecting with everyone through 
sports...!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Any sport that lets you do that is really 
the absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because I encountered so 
much genuine passion through my life at 
Tracen Academy that I was able to realize 
that!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, after going to college, I 
started playing all kinds of sports, and 
every single one of them was so much 
fun...!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Still, as I was doing that, I started 
thinking, 'Isn't this a bit of a waste?'

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
There's no reason Umamusume can't enjoy 
sports other than racing too. We should be 
able to get hyped up for them!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And so, what we started to spread the joy 
of sports was streaming on UmaTube!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And the U.A.F. represents the new 
possibilities in Umamusume sports that I 
have been searching for...!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make the 'U.A.F.' an incredible 
competition that shows the world Umamusume 
can shine in sports other than racing 
too!!"

Hearing those words from Sononet Elfie and 
seeing the fire in her eyes, as someone 
who also engages in sports, I felt a 
passion that couldn't simply be brushed 
aside...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
! YES! I look forward to continuing to 
work with you!

"...And so, after learning how Sonnet 
Elfie felt, we identified the areas <chrname> and I 
needed to improve before the tournament—"

It became a day where <chrname> and I renewed our 
determination to do our best and make the 
U.A.F. a great tournament.
